blocks.text: Refine Your Shape with Liposuction in Tampa

Stubborn fat doesn't always respond to diet and exercise. Liposuction is one of the most effective ways to permanently remove unwanted fat and enhance your natural body contours. Whether you're looking to slim your abdomen, sculpt your waist, define your arms, or improve multiple areas at once, our providers offer customized liposuction procedures designed to create balanced, natural-looking results.

At Tampa Bay Body Sculpting, we help patients find the right procedure based on their goals, anatomy, and desired outcome. During your complimentary virtual consultation, we'll review your goals and help determine which liposuction procedure is the best fit for you.
Schedule Your Complimentary Consultation

Male Liposuction

Lipo 360 contours the abdomen, waist, flanks, and lower back to create a slimmer, more balanced silhouette. It's one of our most popular body contouring procedures for comprehensive midsection sculpting.

Male liposuction is designed to enhance masculine contours by removing stubborn fat from the abdomen, flanks, chest, back, and other treatment areas. Our providers customize each procedure to achieve natural, athletic-looking results.

A Brazilian Butt Lift combines liposuction with fat transfer to enhance the shape and volume of the buttocks using your own fat. This procedure creates a more sculpted body while improving overall proportions.
Arm Liposuction
Fat Transfer Breast Augmentation

Arm liposuction removes stubborn fat from the upper arms to create a leaner, more toned appearance. It's an excellent option for patients who struggle with excess arm fullness despite diet and exercise.
Male Abdominal Sculpting

Male abdominal sculpting, also known as six-pack liposuction or abdominal etching, enhances the natural definition of the abdominal muscles for a more athletic appearance. This procedure is best suited for men who are already in good physical shape with low body fat.

Fat transfer breast augmentation uses purified fat removed during liposuction to naturally enhance breast volume and shape without implants. It's an excellent option for patients seeking subtle, natural-looking enhancement.

Lipo360 Results
First 24 Hours After Liposuction

After liposuction surgery, you may experience mild to moderate discomfort, along with swelling and bruising. You might notice fluid drainage from incision sites and a feeling of tightness in the treated areas. Additionally, fatigue from anesthesia and surgery is common as your body begins the process of stubborn fat removal, ultimately leading to natural-looking results.
First Week of Recovery

Continue light walking throughout the day to support your recovery after body contouring. Stay hydrated to help your body achieve natural-looking results. Focus on consuming protein-rich foods to aid in stubborn fat removal. Avoid strenuous activity during your recovery phase and follow all post-operative instructions provided by your surgical team.
Weeks 2–4

As bruising continues to fade, you'll notice that swelling gradually improves and energy levels start to increase. Walking and light activity become easier, allowing you to enjoy the benefits of body contouring. Over time, the results will reveal a more defined silhouette, showcasing the natural-looking results of stubborn fat removal.
Weeks 4–6
Recovery Tips

Most bruising has disappeared, and the swelling continues to improve, allowing for a more comfortable fit in clothing. As you recover from body contouring, physical activity can gradually increase, leading to more natural-looking results. The effects of stubborn fat removal become increasingly visible over time.

Stay hydrated to support your body contouring journey. Wearing compression garments can enhance your recovery and contribute to natural-looking results. Incorporate protein-rich foods into your diet to aid in stubborn fat removal. Make walking a daily habit to promote overall wellness. Always follow your provider's instructions for optimal recovery.

faqs.q: Is Liposuction permanent?
faqs.a: Yes. Fat cells removed during liposuction are permanently eliminated. Maintaining a stable weight helps preserve your results.

faqs.q: Can Liposuction help me lose weight?
faqs.a: Liposuction is designed for body contouring, not weight loss. It works best for patients who are already close to their goal weight but have localized fat deposits.

faqs.q: How much fat can be removed with Liposuction?
faqs.a: The amount varies based on your anatomy, safety guidelines, and treatment plan. Your provider will discuss what can safely be achieved during your consultation.

faqs.q: Will Liposuction tighten loose skin?
faqs.a: Liposuction removes fat but does not significantly tighten loose skin. Patients with excess skin may benefit from procedures such as a tummy tuck, arm lift, or thigh lift.

faqs.q: Can multiple areas be treated with Liposuction during one surgery?
faqs.a: Yes. Many patients choose to combine multiple treatment areas, such as the abdomen, flanks, back, and arms, to achieve more comprehensive body contouring.

faqs.q: What are financing options for Liposuction?
faqs.a: We offer financing options to help make Liposuction more affordable. During your consultation, we'll review available payment plans and financing solutions so you can choose the option that best fits your budget.

faqs.q: How long do Liposuction results last?
faqs.a: Results from Liposuction can be long-lasting when combined with a stable weight and healthy lifestyle. Once fat cells are removed, they do not return.

faqs.q: Can I combine Liposuction with Breast Surgery?
faqs.a: Yes. Many patients choose to combine liposuction with breast augmentation, breast lift, breast reduction, or fat transfer breast augmentation to achieve more comprehensive body contouring. Combining procedures can address multiple concerns during a single surgery and reduce the need for multiple recovery periods. During your consultation, our providers will determine which procedures can be safely performed together.

faqs.q: Can Liposuction be combined with Abdominal Contouring?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Patients with excess fat and loose abdominal skin often achieve the best results by combining liposuction with abdominal contouring procedures, such as a tummy tuck or mini tummy tuck. Liposuction removes stubborn fat, while abdominal contouring tightens loose skin and repairs separated abdominal muscles when needed.

faqs.q: Can I combine Liposuction with a Mommy Makeover?
faqs.a: Yes. Liposuction is one of the most common procedures included in a Mommy Makeover. Depending on your goals, it may be combined with a tummy tuck, breast augmentation, breast lift, breast reduction, or fat transfer procedures to restore your figure after pregnancy and childbirth.

faqs.a: Yes. Liposuction is one of the most popular cosmetic procedures for men. It can remove stubborn fat from the abdomen, flanks, chest, back, and neck to create a leaner, more athletic appearance. Our providers also offer specialized male body contouring procedures tailored to masculine anatomy.

Male abdominal sculpting, often called six-pack liposuction or abdominal etching, uses advanced liposuction techniques to enhance the natural lines of the abdominal muscles. Common options include a Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL) to enhance the buttocks or fat transfer breast augmentation for patients seeking a natural increase in breast volume without implants.
